indicators.name: linked_contract_count
indicators.formula: count(linked contracts with fact_state in {CONFIRMED, PROBABLE})
indicators.limitations: Computed over notices linked in THIS alpha dataset only; published-notice visibility is not a complete measure of public-sector activity or dependence.
indicators.safe_to_display_reason: Pure count of evidenced links; no interpretation attached.

indicators.name: possible_links_count
indicators.limitations: Candidate matches pending review; excluded from all headline figures.

indicators.name: visible_contract_value_gbp
indicators.formula: sum(award value.amount where currency==GBP over headline-linked notices)
indicators.limitations: 0 of 3 linked notices have no usable GBP value and are excluded. Published values may be estimates or ceilings. Computed over notices linked in THIS alpha dataset only; published-notice visibility is not a complete measure of public-sector activity or dependence.
indicators.safe_to_display_reason: Sum of source-published values only, labelled 'visible'.

indicators.name: buyer_authority_count
indicators.formula: count(distinct normalised buyer names over headline-linked notices)
indicators.limitations: Buyer names are not canonicalised across sources; duplicates under different spellings may over- or under-count. Computed over notices linked in THIS alpha dataset only; published-notice visibility is not a complete measure of public-sector activity or dependence.
indicators.safe_to_display_reason: Count of distinct named buyers in evidence.

indicators.name: service_category_count
indicators.formula: count(distinct CPV 2-digit divisions over headline-linked notices)
indicators.limitations: CPV coding quality varies by buyer. Computed over notices linked in THIS alpha dataset only; published-notice visibility is not a complete measure of public-sector activity or dependence.

indicators.name: buyer_concentration_top_share
indicators.formula: max(buyer visible GBP value) / total visible GBP value
indicators.limitations: Value coverage is partial (3/3 notices valued); top buyer (normalised) = 'fixture department for testing'. Computed over notices linked in THIS alpha dataset only; published-notice visibility is not a complete measure of public-sector activity or dependence.
indicators.safe_to_display_reason: Neutral concentration ratio over published values.

indicators.name: expiry_clustering
indicators.formula: max over rolling 12-month windows of share(linked contracts with end date in window), among contracts with an end date
indicators.limitations: Only 3/3 linked notices publish an end date; extensions/terminations not visible. Computed over notices linked in THIS alpha dataset only; published-notice visibility is not a complete measure of public-sector activity or dependence.
indicators.safe_to_display_reason: Descriptive clustering of published end dates.

indicators.name: direct_award_share
indicators.formula: count(procurementMethod in {direct, limited}) / count(notices with procurementMethod present)
indicators.limitations: Only 3/3 linked notices publish a procedure type; OCDS 'limited' covers several lawful routes. This is a source-supported procedural statistic, not an assessment. Computed over notices linked in THIS alpha dataset only; published-notice visibility is not a complete measure of public-sector activity or dependence.
indicators.safe_to_display_reason: Directly derived from the source's own procedure field.

indicators.name: missing_data_score
indicators.formula: share(headline-linked notices missing any of: value, end date, supplier identifier)
indicators.limitations: Higher means weaker records, not worse behaviour.

indicators.name: evidence_confidence_score
indicators.limitations: Reflects evidence strength of the linkage itself.
indicators.safe_to_display_reason: Meta-metric on the atlas's own evidence.
